summary: Anthropic announced an expanded partnership with Cognizant, under which Cognizant embeds Claude across its internal engineering platforms, certifies its workforce on Claude, and becomes a Global Premier Partner in the Claude Partner Network to deliver Claude-based solutions to enterprise clients.

categories.reason: One customer deployment example describes Claude used by underwriters to evaluate insurance accounts, an underwriting workflow.
categories.quote: risk-navigation tool that has helped underwriters evaluate accounts, which once took hours of manual research, in minutes—saving each person roughly eight hours a week in that deployment.

practices.reason: Describes a spec-driven pattern where a platform directs Claude Code using specifications and architectural blueprints then evaluates output before production, but gives no quantified gain for this specific pattern.
practices.quote: lowsource directs Claude Code using the specifications, coding standards, and architectural blueprints a project defines, then and then evaluates the output before production.
